card.name: Digit 0 inside decimal numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 0 typed right after a decimal point or after other decimal digits, inside a number with a fractional part. Often a trailing or padding zero in measurements, tables or constants.

modes.label: Zero after decimals
modes.description: A 0 as the last or a middle digit of a decimal value with units following.
